response.overview: Originally generated from 2002-2004 in the heart of the San Fernando Valley, this film was made with the assistance of several birds. At the time I had a nice large aviary in my back yard which needed regular attention. Happening to be right outside my film studio, I created a system by which the bird droppings would run off the edge of aviary into a bucket of found footage. Working with three specific stocks, B&W reversal, B&W negative, and Kodachrome they were systematically treated over a two-year period. All of what you see is how it landed, some came off in early projections, though the feathers that did remain I reinforced with tape. Much restoration was needed including persuading Fotokem, a Hollywood lab, to run this shit through their nice machines. -cvb
response.title: Bird Shit Studie #3
